title: MetaGen: Self-Evolving Roles and Topologies for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on an architectural framework (MetaGen) for optimizing multi-agent Large Language Model communication and role assignment. It evaluates performance using technical reasoning and coding benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, HumanEval, MMLU) and does not address religion, morals, or ethics.
